superseded_runs.reason: Qt test variable collided with the slots macro; CLI shared array check assumed Shimada layout for new Granite reports. Runtime code unchanged.
Superseded by full matrix with both GUI and CLI test fixes.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: Application inputs match the successful matrix commit. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
PM CCD mapping is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. It maps presence-mask order to firmware target IDs, not OS CPUs/APICs or active cores.

Per-core/CCD storage boundaries are verified against MP5 copy instructions. Field labels, units, active core masks, OS CPU/APIC mapping, and dual-rail voltage consumption/readback remain unverified; runtime 61h stays denied.
Granite Ridge native capture is restricted to family 1Ah/model 44h, PCI 1022:14d8/BDF 0, SMU 98.84.0 and exact table 620105/1828 or 620205/2452. Physical units and topology remain unverified.
Other AMD firmware and tuning, PStates writes, Curve Shaper, remaining Intel server/board controls and dynamic memory/EC remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed original 1400x1000 EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04 PNGs. Granite platform, disabled CCD mapping, 2452-byte metadata, raw words/offsets and unverified units are visible; controls/status do not overlap or clip. Scrolling is expected for long stored tables. All data is synthetic.

limitations: Static discovery still has undecoded functions; only the byte-checked selected handlers and slices are relied on.
FP normalization/address-update semantics, physical units and OS/CCD mapping remain unverified.
61h storage behavior does not establish rail identities, consumers or a second-rail readback protocol.
Mailbox helper stubs and synthetic replay do not establish live timing, freshness or atomicity.
Public ASUS 2503 is a reference, not the installed BIOS.
